name: OctoBench
intro: OctoBench 是面向代码智能体指令遵循的可执行基准：它把代码库策略、技能文档、系统与用户提示、记忆、工具模式及提醒打包进 34 个自包含环境，以 217 个任务和 7,098 项二元检查同时衡量任务成功与跨来源约束遵循。
build_method: 人工种子编写, 模型辅助扩展, 人机联合检查表审计
modality: 文本, 代码, 工具轨迹
task_type: 代码智能体任务, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 可执行环境, 细粒度二元检查, 多评审轨迹判定
scale: 34个环境；217个任务；7,098项二元检查；另含32个冲突实例
build_method_en: Human Seed Authoring, Model-assisted Expansion, Joint Human-LLM Checklist Audit
eval_feature_en: Executable Environments, Fine-grained Binary Checks, Multi-judge Trajectory Grading
intro_en: OctoBench is an executable benchmark for instruction-following coding agents. It packages repository policies, skill documents, system and user prompts, memory, tool schemas, and reminders into 34 self-contained environments, using 217 tasks and 7,098 binary checks to measure both task success and compliance with constraints from every source.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.10343 Sections 3–5 and the official MiniMaxAI/OctoBench dataset. The diagrams preserve the seven instruction-source families, self-contained Docker environments, three scaffolds, 72 manually authored seed instances, model-assisted expansion to 217 tasks, 16 independent GPT-5.1 reference rollouts per task, atomic evidence-backed binary checks, checklist deduplication and harmonization, joint human-LLM review, 20% manual spot check and stratified double-annotator audit, the 34-environment/7,098-check main release, and the paper's separate 32-instance conflict set. Evaluation uses full proxy-logged trajectories normalized into messages and tools, three independent judges, and both all-applicable-check ISR and check-level CSR.
